What and why
At Microsoft Ignite 2026, Microsoft announced new and upcoming Windows capabilities across security, device and application management, recovery, and agent management. The announcements include developments in four key areas: 
  • Windows management: Updates to Windows Autopatch, application management, device health monitoring, and recovery. Additional developments include server management coming to Microsoft Intune with Windows Server 2028, the evolution of Windows declarative management, and controls for AI agents. 
  • Windows baseline protection: A new approach to establishing, maintaining, and verifying foundational Windows security configurations. 
  • Endpoint security and reliability: The latest updates to the Windows endpoint security platform and Driver Quality Initiative designed to improve system resilience and reduce disruptions associated with security software and drivers. 
  • Passwordless authentication: Expanded Windows Hello, web sign-in, and security key capabilities to support passwordless authentication across more scenarios.
 
Rollout schedule
Availability varies by capability. Refer to the linked articles for current availability, rollout timelines, prerequisites, and supported configurations.
 
Impact on your organization
These investments focus on helping your organization maintain secure, reliable, and up-to-date Windows environments while reducing administrative complexity.
 
Action required/recommendations
No immediate action is required. Today’s announcements can be used to identify capabilities of interest, review prerequisites and supported configurations, and plan for availability.

For more context on the Windows announcements, see:
  • Microsoft Ignite 2026: Building Windows for the next era of work
  • Windows security at Ignite 2026: Start secure, protect what matters, prepare for AI

Compliance considerations
No specific compliance considerations are associated with these announcements. We recommend that you evaluate individual capabilities against your existing security and compliance requirements.

Title: New and upcoming Windows security and management capabilities
